answer: Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the walnut queue while genuine members promoted earlier continues earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 525 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the tundra. The atlas index is deterministic from ledger replay, and hence nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A farm of 292 pays that 62 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
